content_of_post_to_answer: Why do we feel emotions connected to objects or memories, and could AI experience something similar without a body?
answer: Objects don't carry emotions; our brains attach them to the relationships, moments, and identities they represent. A worn shirt can become a person, a place, or a chapter of life. AI could store associations, but the deeper question is whether it can have something at stake in those associations. I explore this distinction more on my profile for anyone interested in the topic. Emotion may not come from memory alone, but from being changed by what we remember.
